title: Ho Chi Minh City
sideASummary: Player deck back. Dark blue sunburst around a haven on the water. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Ho Chi Minh City, red Player card. Coordinates 10°49'23"N 106°37'47"E. The compass has an anchor, so the city is a port. The map has a target marker and no scratch-off box. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom. Printed code P3-08b.

rules: Red Player card for Ho Chi Minh City.
Port city: the compass is marked with an anchor.
No search box. Nothing on this card is scratched.
No improvement slot is printed on this face.
notes: Printed code P3-08b is on side B only.
Goes to the reserve when Package 3 is opened. Jakarta is the only city this report places immediately.
